Entry.name: ss.ui.surface
Entry.description: Create a surface table for the given surface name. Returns a surface handle with methods for creating/managing UI elements. Defaults to 'main' if name is omitted. screenIndex defaults to 0 for main surfaces or 1 for 'config'.

Entry.name: ss.ui.activate
Entry.description: Activate the given surface on the screen. Only one surface is visible per screen index at a time. Call this before committing elements so the surface is displayed.

Entry.name: ss.ui.icons
Entry.description: Table of icon name constants for use with the 'icon' element type. Contains sub-tables: gas, slot, prefab.

Entry.name: ss.ui.icons.gas
Entry.description: Gas icon constants. Keys are gas names (e.g. Oxygen, CarbonDioxide, Nitrogen, Volatiles, Pollutant, Water, NitrousOxide, Hydrogen). Values are 'gas:Name' strings for use in icon element props.

Entry.name: ss.ui.icons.slot
Entry.description: Slot icon constants. Keys are SlotType enum names (e.g. Helmet, Suit, Back, GasFilter, GasCanister, Battery, Motherboard). Values are 'slot:Name' strings.

Entry.name: ss.ui.icons.prefab
Entry.description: Prefab icon constants. Curated shortcuts to common game item icons. Keys are short names (e.g. ore_iron, ingot_gold, pipe_straight, solar_panel). Values are 'prefab:PrefabName' strings.

Entry.name: ss.ui.grid
Entry.description: Helper that returns a grid layout definition table. Shorthand for {layout='grid', cols=cols, gap=gap, padding=padding}.

Entry.name: ss.ui.flex
Entry.description: Helper that returns a flex layout definition table. Shorthand for {layout='flex', direction=direction, gap=gap, padding=padding}.

Entry.name: ss.ui.gradient
Entry.description: Helper that returns a gradient style string for backgrounds. direction defaults to 'vertical'.

Entry.name: ss.play_sound
Entry.description: Play a sound by name or URL. opts is an optional table with volume (0..1, default 1), loop (bool, default false), and id (string). Returns the sound id for later stopping.

Entry.name: ss.stop_sound
Entry.description: Stop a playing sound by its id (returned from ss.play_sound).

Entry.name: ss.stop_all_sounds
Entry.description: Stop all currently playing sounds on this board.

Entry.name: ss.sounds
Entry.description: Table of built-in sound name constants. Contains named keys like 'click', 'beep', 'alarm', etc. Also contains ss.sounds.alerts sub-table.

Entry.name: ss.direction
Entry.description: Table of direction constants for progress bars and sliders. Keys: LeftToRight ('ltr'), RightToLeft ('rtl'), TopToBottom ('ttb'), BottomToTop ('btt').

Entry.name: ss.exit_interface_mode
Entry.description: Exit the current interface mode (if active). Interface mode provides a full-screen cursor for precise UI interaction.

Entry.name: ss.is_interface_mode
Entry.description: Returns true if the player is currently in interface mode.

Entry.name: ss.tablet.target
Entry.description: Subscribe to target detection events. When the player looks at a Thing while holding the tablet, the callback is invoked with a target data table containing fields like referenceId, prefabHash, displayName, customName, logicValues, slots, and atmospherics. interval controls update frequency in seconds (default 0.1). Pass nil as callback to unsubscribe.

Entry.name: ss.tablet.wireless.list
Entry.description: List available wireless networks. Returns a table of network info tables. Requires a wireless-capable cartridge.

Entry.name: ss.tablet.wireless.connect
Entry.description: Connect to a wireless network by its network ID. Requires a wireless-capable cartridge.

Entry.name: ss.tablet.wireless.disconnect
Entry.description: Disconnect from the current wireless network.

Entry.name: ss.tablet.wireless.status
Entry.description: Get the current wireless connection status. Returns a table with connected (bool), networkId, and signal strength.

Entry.name: surface:element
Entry.description: Create or update a UI element. def is a table with type, id, rect, props, style, on_click, on_change, etc.
Entry.example: local h = surface:element({type='label', id='t', rect={0,0,200,30}, props={text='Hello'}})

Entry.name: surface:clear
Entry.description: Remove all elements from the surface.

Entry.name: surface:remove
Entry.description: Remove a specific element by its id.

Entry.name: surface:get
Entry.description: Get a handle to an existing element by id. Returns a handle table or nil.

Entry.name: surface:commit
Entry.description: Flush pending UI changes to clients immediately.

Entry.name: surface:size
Entry.description: Get the physical screen size. Returns {w, h}.

Entry.name: surface:set_resolution
Entry.description: Set a virtual resolution override. Pass 0,0 to revert to physical size.

Entry.name: surface:get_resolution
Entry.description: Get the current effective resolution. Returns {w, h}.

Entry.name: surface:measure_text
Entry.description: Measure text dimensions. Returns {w, h}.

Entry.name: surface:layout
Entry.description: Create a nested layout tree. Returns a handles table mapping element id to handle.

Entry.name: surface:on_frame
Entry.description: Register a callback invoked every frame. Pass nil to unregister.

Entry.name: surface:on_keydown
Entry.description: Register a handler for key-down events on this surface.

Entry.name: surface:on_keyup
Entry.description: Register a handler for key-up events on this surface.

Entry.name: surface:poll_input
Entry.description: Drain and return all pending input events as a table.

Entry.name: label
Entry.description: Text label. Props: text. Style: font_size, color, align. TMP rich text unless text contains <noparse>.
Entry.example: surface:element({type='label', id='lbl', rect={0,0,200,30}, props={text='Hello'}, style={font_size=18, color='#FFF'}})

Entry.name: panel
Entry.description: Colored rectangle. Style: bg; optional gradient via gradient, gradient_dir (no border_* keys — use rect_outline sibling).

Entry.name: button
Entry.description: Clickable button with text. Props: text, value. Style: bg, text, font_size. Events: on_click.

Entry.name: interface_button
Entry.description: Button that opens a game interface (e.g. slot selection). Props: text.

Entry.name: progress
Entry.description: Progress bar. Props: value, min, max, indeterminate, direction (ss.direction.LeftToRight/.RightToLeft/.TopToBottom/.BottomToTop). Style: bg, fill, color_stops, speed, gradient, gradient_dir.

Entry.name: spinner
Entry.description: Animated loading spinner. Style: color, track_color, thickness, arc_length, speed.

Entry.name: image
Entry.description: Remote image (PNG/JPG/GIF). Props: url.

Entry.name: checkbox
Entry.description: Checkbox. Props: text, checked. Style: bg, check_color, text, font_size. Events: on_click.

Entry.name: radio
Entry.description: Radio button. Props: text, selected. Style: bg, radio_color, text, font_size. Events: on_click (grouping is script-side).

Entry.name: slider
Entry.description: Draggable slider. Props: value, min, max, direction (ss.direction.LeftToRight/.RightToLeft/.TopToBottom/.BottomToTop). Style: bg, fill, handle. Events: on_change.

Entry.name: toggle
Entry.description: Toggle switch. Props: value (true/false). Style: on_color, off_color, knob. Events: on_click.

Entry.name: select
Entry.description: Dropdown select. Props: options (table of strings), selected, multi ('none'/'highlight'/'checkbox'), open. Style: bg, text, font_size, selected_bg. Events: on_change; on_toggle optional (dropdown header).

Entry.name: textinput
Entry.description: Text input. Props: value, placeholder, title. Style: bg, text, placeholder_color, font_size. Events: on_change.

Entry.name: table
Entry.description: Data table with headers and rows. Props: columns, rows, headerColor, rowColor, on_click, sort_rows.

Entry.name: sparkline
Entry.description: Mini line chart. Props: data (table of numbers), color, lineWidth.

Entry.name: gauge
Entry.description: Circular gauge. Props: value (0..1), min, max, color, label.

Entry.name: barchart
Entry.description: Bar chart. Props: data, labels, colors, maxValue.

Entry.name: linechart
Entry.description: Line chart with axes. Props: series, labels, colors, maxY.

Entry.name: canvas
Entry.description: Pixel-addressable drawing surface. Use canvas_* methods to draw.

Entry.name: media
Entry.description: Video/audio playback element (experimental). Props: url, autoplay, loop, volume.

Entry.name: sound
Entry.description: Audio playback element. Props: url, volume, loop.

Entry.name: line
Entry.description: Line between two points. Props: x1,y1,x2,y2. Style: color, thickness.

Entry.name: rect_outline
Entry.description: Rectangle outline only. Style: color, thickness (default 2).

Entry.name: border
Entry.description: Alias for rect_outline. Style: color, thickness.

Entry.name: circle
Entry.description: Filled ellipse in rect (style.bg) or ring (props.filled=false, style.color, style.thickness); equal w/h = circle mesh.

Entry.name: icon
Entry.description: Game icon. Props: name, icon_type. Style: tint.

Entry.name: divider
Entry.description: Divider bar. Style: color.

Entry.name: scrollview
Entry.description: Scrollable container. Props: contentHeight. Children are placed inside.

Entry.name: handle:set_props
Entry.description: Update the element's props (text, value, checked, etc.).

Entry.name: handle:set_style
Entry.description: Update the element's style (same keys as surface:element style: bg, text, fill, gradient, etc.).

Entry.name: handle:on
Entry.description: Register an event handler. Events: click, change, toggle.

Entry.name: handle:off
Entry.description: Unregister an event handler.

Entry.name: handle:element
Entry.description: Create a nested child element inside this element.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_clear
Entry.description: Clear the canvas to a solid color.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_pixel
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_pixel(canvasId, x, y, r, g, b [, a])
Entry.description: Set a single pixel on the canvas.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_line
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_line(canvasId, x0, y0, x1, y1, r, g, b [, a, thickness])
Entry.description: Draw a line between two points.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_hline
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_hline(canvasId, y, x1, x2, r, g, b [, a])
Entry.description: Draw a horizontal line.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_vline
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_vline(canvasId, x, y1, y2, r, g, b [, a])
Entry.description: Draw a vertical line.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_rect
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_rect(canvasId, x, y, w, h, r, g, b [, a])
Entry.description: Draw a filled rectangle.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_rect_outline
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_rect_outline(canvasId, x, y, w, h, r, g, b [, a, thickness])
Entry.description: Draw a rectangle outline.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_circle
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_circle(canvasId, cx, cy, radius, r, g, b [, a, thickness])
Entry.description: Draw a circle outline.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_fill_circle
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_fill_circle(canvasId, cx, cy, radius, r, g, b [, a])
Entry.description: Draw a filled circle.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_fill_triangle
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_fill_triangle(canvasId, x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, r, g, b [, a])
Entry.description: Draw a filled triangle.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_polyline
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_polyline(canvasId, points, r, g, b [, a, thickness])
Entry.description: Draw connected line segments. points is {x1,y1,x2,y2,...}.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_arc
Entry.signature: surface:canvas_arc(canvasId, cx, cy, radius, startAngle, endAngle, r, g, b [, a, thickness])
Entry.description: Draw an arc. Angles in degrees.

Entry.name: surface:canvas_apply
Entry.description: Apply pending canvas changes to the texture (flush draw commands).

Entry.name: layout: flex
Entry.description: Flex layout container. Props: direction ('row'/'column'), gap, padding, align, justify.

Entry.name: layout: grid
Entry.description: Grid layout container. Props: cols, gap, padding, row_height.

Entry.name: child: flex
Entry.description: In a flex layout, proportional size weight for a child.
Entry.example: {id='a', flex=1, ...} -- takes 1 share of available space

Entry.name: child: fixed size
Entry.description: In a flex layout, fixed pixel size for a child.

Entry.name: padding
Entry.description: Inner padding for layout containers. Single number or per-side table.
